n, k, P = map(int, input().split())

N = 10**6 + 10
fac = [1] * N
ifac = [1] * N
f = [0] * N
g = [0] * N

def qpow(a, n):
    r = 1 % P
    a %= P
    while n:
        if n & 1:
            r = r * a % P
        a = a * a % P
        n >>= 1
    return r

def inv(x):
    return 1 if x <= 1 else inv(P % x) * (P - P // x) % P

def add(a, b):
    return (a + b) % P

for i in range(1, N):
    fac[i] = fac[i - 1] * i % P

ifac[N - 1] = inv(fac[N - 1])
for i in range(N - 2, -1, -1):
    ifac[i] = ifac[i + 1] * (i + 1) % P

ans = qpow(k, n)

if n % 2 == 0:
    f[n] = fac[n]
    for z in range(1, k + 1):
        for i in range(n + 1):
            g[i] = 0
        i = n
        while i:
            if f[i]:
                j = i
                while True:
                    add_value = (f[i] * ifac[j]) % P
                    g[i ^ j] = (g[i ^ j] + add_value) % P
                    if (j - 1) & i == j - 1:
                        j = (j - 1) & i
                        if j < 2 * j:
                            break
                    else:
                        break
        for i in range(n + 1):
            f[i] = g[i]
        res = f[0]
        for j in range(z):
            res = res * (k - j) % P
        ans = (ans - res) % P

if ans < 0:
    ans += P

print(ans)
